title: Choosing no background restriction ensures there will be no delay in notifications, connectivity loss and proper functioning of watch features including, Camera shutter and Find device.

data.text: 1. Open the system settings of the phone.
2. Search for "Battery optimisation" in the search box.
3. Click into Battery Optimisation and select "All apps" as the filter in the upper left corner.
4. Find NoiseFit, select Don't allow and click OK.
